en.sayed-ali-raza: do pour on us Thy mercy, Thy blessing, Thy sustenance and Thy pity,
and make us enjoy a drink which benefits us, quenches our thirst, produces green herbage
with which all that was lost gets a growing and all that had withered comes to life again.
It should bring about the benefit of freshness and plentifulness of ripe fruits.
With it plains may be watered, rivers may begin flowing,
plants may pick up foliage and prices may come down.
Surely, Thou art powerful over whatever Thou willest.
